headline: Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited: Outcome of Board Meeting
sum: Outcome of Board Meeting - Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026 and sale / divestment of the Company's entire (100%) shareholding in Bajaj Hindusthan…
detail: Outcome of Board Meeting - Bajaj Hindusthan Sugar Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026 and sale / divestment of the Company's entire (100%) shareholding in Bajaj Hindusthan (Singapore) Private Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
